gates.closureDefinition: Three permission-scoped confirmations across three projects.
Five uncoached sessions across at least two target reader groups.
Three cleared, consent-resolved visual proofs across three projects.
A bounded application sample with real response observations.
Approved deploy, route observation, rollback evidence, and postdeploy smoke results.
Jamie's explicit approval of the exact candidate commit, content, artifacts, and indexing state.

boundary: An agent may improve governance and prepare review packets. It may not convert a protocol, public article, archive record, AI review, or model scorecard into human or external closure.
